performance comparable to an Intel Core Ultra 7 155H and an Apple M3 ... The Surface Pro's battery life is just under 13 hours streaming video, as promised

praises: 4.91★/35 on BBY for this SKU — best-rated Pro 11 tier; OLED + battery + silence is the recurring trio
Performance comparable to Core Ultra 7 155H / Apple M3 (CNET) — finally no ARM performance apology
Performance holds on battery, unlike x86 convertibles (CNET)
NPU 'blew the Core Ultra away' (CNET) — class-leading local AI at launch
1 TB suits creators who store projects locally; SSD still replaceable under kickstand
complaints: Keyboard + pen add CA$400-560 — CNET con: 'Optional Pen and keyboard can get expensive'

design_philosophy: The definitive Surface Pro and the exact configuration reviewers benchmarked: OLED 120Hz, Snapdragon X Elite, 45-TOPS NPU, fanless 895 g magnesium chassis. CNET's as-reviewed 16GB/1TB tier trades RAM for storage — Microsoft's tiering forces a 32GB jump for memory headroom, which is why this config satisfies most buyers but not heavy multitaskers.
rating_notes: Direct anchor: CNET 8.3/10 on this exact configuration (as-reviewed US$1,950). BBY users rate it higher (4.91★/35) — screen and battery praised more effusively than the review; heat-while-charging and accessory-cost complaints match CNET cons exactly. Ecosystem 7.5 = ARM Windows translation caveats per dataset calibration (X Elite app compat 'a lot fewer issues' but not zero).
